result.summary: Both slots and all six R groups pass the audit. Slot a (E, core K screen moved onto S/Q/CPV, plus selection mode) scores novelty 3 and soundness 3; seed 13 is struck because it is the reverse-direction control and the reward picks the sign itself, so 12 seeds remain and the core's largest control |ρ| is 0.10. Slot b (N, overnight/intraday split) scores novelty 4 and soundness 3; seed 11 is struck because residualizing on R20 raised its rev |ρ| from 0.13 to 0.42, the opposite of its stated aim, so 11 seeds remain. R soundness scores: R1 3, R2 3, R3 4, R4 4, R5 3, R6 4. The R1 and R6 replacements will add near-duplicates to the library (R6's variant has |ρ| 0.99 with head +1.62). One point checked in the code: the long_neutral reward does not apply the untradable mask (steer.py:627), so frozen-quote and newly listed names are still in the book.
